comment_ja: 📉昨日は30勝20敗2分、1,000円賭け換算で-2,450円。勝った割合は高いものの損益はマイナスだった。注目点はCA Osasuna vs Levanteの「両チーム得点なし」でオッズ1.98の+980円を的中した一方、同試合のO/U1.5オーバーが外れるなど予想が分散した形。累計1,901件で戻ってきた割合は-2.4%と横ばい推移。
comment_en: 📉 Yesterday's record was 30 wins, 20 losses, 2 refunds, resulting in -2,450 yen at 1,000 yen per bet. Despite a solid win rate, the return was negative. A notable hit was 'Both Teams Not to Score' in CA Osasuna vs Levante at odds 1.98 (+980 yen), while the Over 1.5 in the same match missed, reflecting scattered outcomes. Cumulative return rate stands at -2.4% across 1,901 bets.
